objective:
MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 040

Engineering Analysis Engine

Current EngineeringImprovementService is producing generalized engineering reports.

It is not performing true code analysis.

Upgrade EngineeringImprovementService into a real engineering analysis engine.

Requirements

When analyzing source code:

• identify the exact file

• identify the exact function

• identify the exact decision path

• identify the exact condition that matched

• identify the exact fallback condition

• identify unreachable logic

• identify duplicate routing logic

• identify obsolete keyword routing

• identify conflicting execution paths

Every finding must include:

File

Function

Reason

Evidence

Recommended Fix

Do not produce generalized recommendations.

Produce evidence-based engineering analysis.

Validation

Run the analysis against:

CommandIntentPlannerService.js

ExecutionService.js

BuilderService.js

MilesCommandCenter.js

Return an Executive Engineering Report with evidence.

Do not modify production code.

Only improve EngineeringImprovementService.
